title: Technical Training Manager
description:
Lead & drive the Nuclear steam turbine & generator manufacturing technical training program across all the product lines . Manage training school for technicians (& staff as needed).
  
  
Person will be accountable for training program management incl. processes like welding, machining & assembly, Testing related training, maintenance training etc. To ensure desired skilled workforce is deputed on production shop as per plan
  
  
It is also desired that persons is able to impart strong Safety & Quality culture amongst the technicians along with technical know-how.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead & drive the training program for various streams of technicians across factory.
* Train & Qualify Welders as per MTP plan & handover to production.
* Understanding of nuclear & services project customer mindset and able to cascade requirements within organization
* Arrange various skill re-fresher & cross skill training related to technical competency.
* Identify gaps on skills & competency with manufacturing COE leaders & plan trainings to fill the gaps.
* Maintain training log & cost associated to each training.
* Identify & maintain necessary equipments in training school plan for their capex & opex investment.
* Maintain training school SQDC performance with other KPI’s & report to management at desired intervals.
* Record the learnings and process improvements and sustain through continuous updating
* Usage of various quality and lean tools viz. VSM, PFMEA, 8D, KAIZEN and 5S
* Empower and support shop technicians process change suggestions and implementation.
* Drive new process qualification and prepare related documentation.
* Continuously improve manufacturing skills & competency.
* Uses technical experience and analytical thinking.
* Devleop SOP’s for visual management as well as training purpose
* Prepare, lead and drive detailed technical documents, videos (wherever possible as demonstration) for welding training for all applicable scope
* Active participation in digitizing all the data point of welding training for welders qualification and all the history as well as future planning
* Adhere to safety standards and adapt Arabelle Solutions Safety, Ethics & compliance rules
* Lead and drive daily management system with clear reporting of daily progress

**Key Performance Indicators**

* EHS and Lean
* Skills & Competence Development plan vs actual
* Train the trainers & technicians
* SQDC KPI’s performance related to training program
* Continuous improvement & Cost reduction

**Desired Skill Set**

* Good knowledge of various manufacturing processes like fabricaiton, welding, machining, assembly & testing.
* Excellent ability to impart training to new comers & experience personals both.
* Understanding of manufacturing process flow & various skills & competencies associated to that.
* Thorough understanding of Engineering Drawings, Standards and Specifications
* Strong EHS & quality focus
* Strong interpersonal and leadership and Training skills
* Good Software skills (AutoCAD, Catia, SAP)
* Good knowledge of ASME, EN, IBR, IS standard.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Vendor development skills for new products and processes development.
* Demonstrated integrity – accept and adhere to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, and actions when dealing with others.
* Resolves internal issues quickly to meet customer expectations
* Able to work cross functional teams to generate customer solutions as the final goal

**Required Qualifications**

* BE/BTech/Diploma in Mechanical /Production min 10 years of relevant experience – min 5-yearcore experience of production/process of heavy fabrication.

Experience in training school will be added advantage.
  
  
Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
  
  
At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Jr / Sr. Career Advisor - US IT Staffing
description:
**About the job**

**Role:**
Jr / Sr. Career Advisor -US IT Staffing

**Location:**
Visnagar

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-Site

**Shift:**
Night Shift

**Salary:**
Competitive and Based on Experience Level

**About Upward**

Upward Jobs is a Career Acceleration Platform designed to help tech professionals navigate the modern job market efficiently. The organization believes that securing a high-paying role should be straightforward, supported, and less overwhelming. Through AI-driven job matching, dedicated recruiter outreach, and personalized mentorship, Upward Jobs helps candidates advance their careers, not just fill any available role.

Serving in-demand areas such as Software Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, DevOps, non-IT roles, and related technology fields, Upward Jobs focuses on high-impact career placements. With over 500 success stories, the company is redefining how tech talent connects with the right opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Jr / Sr. Career Advisor - US IT Staffing who is passionate about working with people and helping technology professionals achieve their career goals.

The role involves understanding candidates' skills, experience, interests, career aspirations, and job preferences and guiding them toward suitable opportunities within the US IT market.

The Career Advisor will work closely with candidates and internal recruitment teams to provide career guidance, profile optimization, interview preparation, job-search support, and continuous assistance throughout the hiring process.

This is a full-time, on-site position based in Visnagar, Gujarat, and requires working a night shift aligned with US business hours.

**Key Responsibility**

* Conduct one-on-one career counseling sessions and understand candidates' career goals, expectations, and preferences.
* Evaluate candidate profiles, technical skills, professional experience, and interests to identify suitable US IT opportunities.
* Maintain a professional, supportive, and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Guide candidates regarding career paths, job requirements, industry expectations, and opportunities within the US technology market.
* Assist candidates with resume and LinkedIn profile optimization.
* Provide interview preparation, coaching, and professional guidance.
* Develop effective job-search strategies based on individual candidate profiles and career objectives.
* Coordinate with recruitment and marketing teams to understand current job requirements and identify suitable opportunities.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and track candidate progress throughout the hiring process.
* Follow up regularly with candidates and provide timely updates regarding opportunities, applications, interviews, and next steps.
* Develop individualized career development plans based on candidates' professional goals.
* Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with candidates.
* Support candidates throughout the interview and hiring process, including preparation and offer discussions.
* Participate in candidate engagement activities, workshops, training sessions, and information sessions when required.
* Identify opportunities to improve career counseling strategies, processes, and candidate-support tools.

**Qualifications**

* Strong English communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of career counseling, career development, and career management.
* Ability to understand candidate profiles and guide them toward suitable career opportunities.
* Experience in staffing, recruiting, counseling, sales, business development, customer service, or other candidate-facing roles is preferred.
* Exposure to US IT staffing, recruitment, or the US technology job market is an added advantage.
* Strong organizational, follow-up, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple candidates and responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work effectively in an on-site and collaborative environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Counseling, or any other related field is preferred.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, understanding their career goals, providing professional guidance, and helping technology professionals move toward suitable career opportunities.

**The ideal candidate should demonstrate:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Confidence, professionalism, and a positive attitude
* Strong listening and interpersonal skills
* Patience and the ability to understand individual candidate needs
* Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills
* A candidate-focused approach with a genuine interest in career development
* Ability to work in a target-oriented and fast-paced environment
* Willingness to learn about US IT staffing, recruitment processes, and the US technology job market
* Ability to manage multiple candidates and tasks while maintaining accurate records
* Ability to work effectively during the required night shift
* Strong willingness to learn, grow, and develop within the organization

**Why Join Upward Jobs?**

* Opportunity to build a career in US IT Staffing, Career Counseling, and Recruitment
* Exposure to international candidates and the US technology job market
* Opportunity to work with professionals across Software Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, DevOps, and other technology domains
* Professional training, mentorship, and career development opportunities
* Collaborative, supportive, and growth-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to develop strong skills in career counseling, recruitment, candidate management, communication, and relationship building
* Opportunity to contribute to helping technology professionals achieve their career goals
* Career growth opportunities based on performance, skills, and contribution

**Join Upward Jobs**

If you are passionate about helping people, building relationships, and developing a career in the US IT staffing and career advisory industry, we would love to hear from you.

Join
**Upward Jobs**
and become part of a team that connects talented professionals with the right career opportunities.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
**About Company:** 




 Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e\-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers \& All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.
 



  





 While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800\+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
 



  





 For more about Group Bayport, please visit
 



**Website:** 
 https://groupbayport.com/about\-us/
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/
 



  





**Designation: Lead – Talent Acquisition** 




**Location: Gandhinagar** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Talent Acquisition Lead to lead end\-to\-end recruitment initiatives for global manufacturing operations, including domestic and international hiring. The incumbent will be responsible for developing and executing talent acquisition strategies to attract, assess, and hire high\-caliber talent across manufacturing plants, engineering functions, supply chain, operations, quality, projects, R\&D, corporate functions, and leadership positions across India and international markets.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess extensive experience in hiring for global manufacturing organizations and demonstrate expertise in workforce planning, stakeholder management, talent mapping, employer branding, recruitment analytics, and building high\-performing recruitment teams. The role will have significant responsibility for international talent acquisition, cross\-border hiring, global talent mapping, and engagement with talent markets across regions such as the Middle East, Europe, APAC, Africa, and North America.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Talent Acquisition Strategy \& Workforce Planning** 



* Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with organizational growth plans, global manufacturing expansion, and business requirements across domestic and international markets.
* Partner with business leaders, plant heads, and functional leaders to forecast workforce requirements and create hiring roadmaps for India and overseas operations.
* Drive workforce planning, succession pipelines, and talent mapping for critical manufacturing and leadership roles.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for niche engineering, technical, operational, and leadership positions across global talent markets.
* Develop market\-specific recruitment strategies based on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, hiring practices, and local market dynamics.



**Global \& International Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead end\-to\-end international recruitment initiatives across multiple geographies and talent markets.
* Manage hiring mandates for overseas locations and support the organization’s international expansion and global workforce requirements.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies to identify talent from international markets for specialized, technical, leadership, and critical business roles.
* Build and maintain talent pools across regions including Middle East, Europe, APAC, Africa, North America, and other relevant international markets.
* Partner with international recruitment consultants, executive search firms, agencies, professional networks, and industry associations to support global hiring.
* Manage cross\-border recruitment processes while ensuring alignment with applicable hiring practices, documentation requirements, and organizational policies.
* Develop market intelligence on international talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor hiring trends, and talent movement.
* Drive passive candidate engagement and international talent mapping for critical and hard\-to\-fill positions.
* Support relocation and international mobility requirements associated with overseas hiring, in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders.



**Global Manufacturing Recruitment** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for manufacturing, operations, engineering, maintenance, projects, quality, procurement, supply chain, EHS, R\&D, and corporate functions.
* Manage hiring requirements across domestic and international manufacturing locations.
* Develop sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-fill and niche manufacturing roles across local and global talent markets.
* Ensure quality hiring while meeting recruitment timelines and business expectations.
* Support greenfield, brownfield, capacity expansion, and international expansion hiring projects.



**Leadership Hiring \& Talent Mapping** 



* Lead recruitment for senior management and leadership positions across manufacturing and corporate functions, including international mandates.
* Conduct market intelligence, competitor mapping, and talent benchmarking exercises across domestic and international markets.
* Build relationships with industry professionals, consultants, executive search partners, and global talent networks.
* Maintain talent pipelines for succession and future business requirements across geographies.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Partner closely with business leaders, plant heads, functional leaders, and international stakeholders to understand organizational talent needs.
* Provide market insights on domestic and international talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring activities, and market dynamics.
* Conduct periodic hiring reviews with leadership teams and present recruitment dashboards and talent market insights.
* Influence hiring decisions through data\-driven recommendations and talent market intelligence.



**Recruitment Operations \& Process Excellence** 



* Establish robust recruitment processes, governance frameworks, and SOPs for domestic and international hiring.
* Drive ATS adoption, recruitment automation, and process optimization initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, diversity goals, and hiring standards across relevant geographies.
* Monitor and improve key recruitment metrics including:
* Time to Hire
* Cost per Hire
* Offer Acceptance Ratio
* Source Effectiveness
* Quality of Hire
* Hiring Manager Satisfaction
* International Hiring Effectiveness



**Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement** 



* Strengthen the organization's employer brand across domestic and international manufacturing, engineering, and leadership talent markets.
* Drive employer branding initiatives through social media, industry forums, professional networks, and campus engagement.
* Build strategic partnerships with engineering institutes, technical universities, industry associations, and international talent networks.
* Develop initiatives to enhance the organization's visibility as an employer across global talent markets.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle, including international candidates.



**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the Talent Acquisition team supporting domestic and international hiring.
* Establish performance metrics and accountability frameworks for the recruitment team.
* Build sourcing and assessment capabilities through coaching and training.
* Develop the team's capability to manage global sourcing, international recruitment, and cross\-border hiring mandates.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and high\-performance recruiting.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong expertise in Talent Acquisition Strategy and Workforce Planning.
* Proven experience in hiring for global manufacturing, engineering, operations, supply chain, and leadership functions.
* Strong understanding of international talent markets and global recruitment practices.
* Proven experience managing international / cross\-border hiring mandates will be strongly preferred.
* Expertise in talent mapping, executive search, and passive candidate engagement across domestic and international markets.
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills across multiple geographies.
* Strong recruitment analytics and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, and social recruiting.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage large\-scale domestic and international hiring projects and multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong understanding of market\-specific sourcing strategies and candidate engagement approaches.



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or related discipline.
* 10–16 years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading recruitment teams.
* Mandatory experience in global manufacturing, industrial, engineering, EPC, automotive, renewable energy, heavy engineering, chemicals, metals, or process industries.
* Hands\-on experience managing international hiring across one or more regions such as the Middle East, Europe, APAC, Africa, or North America will be preferred.
* Experience managing senior leadership and niche technical hiring across multiple geographies will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to international recruitment agencies, executive search firms, global sourcing platforms, and cross\-border hiring processes will be preferred.
